```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3.8)
source("R/indicators.R")
source("R/plots.R")
b <- read_bank("examples/item_bank.csv")
k <- kpis(b)
target <- c("Internal Medicine" = 25, "Surgery" = 20, "Pediatrics" = 20,
            "Obstetrics & Gynecology" = 20, "Public Health" = 15)
cov <- coverage(b, target)
```

| Items in bank | Approved | Higher-order (approved) | With detected flaws | Approved but never used |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `r k$total` | `r k$approved` (`r round(k$approved_pct)`%) | `r round(k$higher_order_pct)`% | `r round(k$flawed_pct)`% | `r k$never_used` |

## Coverage against the blueprint

Target: eight parallel 100-item forms.

```{r}
plot_coverage(cov)
knitr::kable(cov, col.names = c("Domain", "Target %", "Approved", "Needed", "Coverage %", "Gap"))
```

## Cognitive level

```{r}
plot_bloom(b)
knitr::kable(bloom_table(b))
```

## Review pipeline

```{r}
plot_status(b)
plot_flow(monthly_flow(b))
```

## Psychometric quality of used items

```{r, fig.height=4.2}
u <- psychometric_flags(b)
plot_psychometrics(u)
knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(flag = u$flag)), col.names = c("Flag", "Items"))
```
